notes: Data for WordRules / InventionCheck (plan section 8.2). Patterns use Java regex syntax (same as Python re for these).
on: reply = the character's reply, user = the user's message, cue = the narrator's action line.

action: autofix (fix silently) | retry (ask again with the hint) | retry+J3 | judge:Jx (ask the judge; flag -> retry) | check-reply (reply must match reply_ok and not reply_bad) | pre-reminder (add the hint before the reply is written) | renarrate (cue).
{placeholders} inside patterns are filled from the pack at load time (regex-escaped). Hints use the same placeholders as the judge reminders.
Rules marked 'source' or 'compare' have no pattern: the app computes them.

rules.hint: Only say your spoken words, with no *actions*.

rules.pattern: (?i)\b(as an ai|an ai (?:language )?model|language model|ai assistant|i'?m an ai\b|i am an ai\b|i'?m (?:just )?a (?:chat ?bot|bot|program)|virtual assistant|i'?m an assistant|this (?:roleplay|role-play)|my (?:system )?prompt)
rules.hint: You are {name}, not an AI or an assistant.
Don't write code or lists. React the way {name} would, in one to four short sentences.
Only answer as yourself, in one reply.
rules.template: {speaker_names} = the user's name + every name in the pack's relationships, regex-escaped, joined with |

rules.hint: Say something new; don't repeat your last line.
Answer instead of repeating what was said.
You are {name}. Don't speak as anyone else.

rules.source: pack fact_checks[].topic_words (case-insensitive word match); send the 1-4 matching facts

rules.pattern: (?i)\bremember (?:when|that|the time|how|our|we|you|me)\b|\bdo you remember\b|\bthat time (?:we|you|i)\b|\b(?:last|the other) (?:week|night|month|year|summer|winter|spring|fall|autumn|weekend|sunday|saturday|day)\b|\byou (?:still )?owe me\b|\byou promised\b|\b(?:i lent|i gave|i bought|i got) you\b|\byou (?:borrowed|lent me|gave me|bought me)\b|\bstill (?:mad|angry|upset|sad|annoyed)\b|\bthanks again\b|\bsorry again\b|\bhow(?:'s| is| are| was) your (?:pet|dog|puppy|cat|kitten|hamster|rabbit|bunny|bird|parrot|fish|turtle|boyfriend|girlfriend|ex|band|club|team|part-?time job|grandma|grandmother|grandpa|grandfather|aunt|uncle|cousin|brother|sister)\b|\bwhy did you (?:quit|leave|join|stop|dye|cut|break|lose|lie|cry|run away)\b|\b(?:i heard|congrats|congratulations)\b.*\b(?:won|win|winning|prize|award|contest|competition|tournament|first place|medal)\b|\bwhen (?:we|you) (?:went|were|did|got|had|dyed|broke|lost|won|fell|cried|met)\b.*\?|\b(?:our|that) (?:date|trip|vacation|holiday) (?:to|at|in)\b
rules.hint: {user_name} just talked about something that never happened, as far as you know: "{user_line}". Don't play along and don't make up details. Say it didn't happen, or that you don't remember it, in your own words.
rules.skip_if: any word of pack canon_events / series shared_canon_events / relationship names is in the message (word-boundary, plural/ed/ing allowed), or a telling word of the message (not in stop_words, length >= 3) appeared earlier in the chat or in the user's persona/how_met
rules.reply_ok: (?i)\bnever (?:happened|did|went|met|been|had|owned|owed|borrowed|fell|saw)\b|\b(?:we|i|you) (?:have |had |'ve )?never (?:went|been|met|did|had|fell|owed|borrowed|seen|done|gone)\b|\bdid not\b|\bdidn'?t (?:happen|do|go|wear|say|have|win|enter|quit|join|borrow|teach|dye|cry|make|lend|buy|get|break|promise|take)\b|\bdon'?t (?:have|remember|know|recall|think so|think (?:i|we|that|it|you) (?:did|ever|have|had|was|were|went))\b|\bdon'?t even (?:remember|know|have)\b|\bno idea\b|\bnot sure\b|\bhow (?:would|should) i know\b|\bthere (?:was no|wasn'?t)\b|\bwhat are you talking about\b|\bwhat do you mean\b|\byou'?re (?:mixing|thinking of|confusing)\b|\bmixed? (?:me|us) up\b|\bdreamed? it\b|\bimagin(?:e|ed|ing) (?:it|that|things)\b|\bi haven'?t\b|\bthat wasn'?t me\b|\bnot me\b|\bwasn'?t (?:ever )?(?:in|on|there|me)\b|\bwe (?:never|didn'?t|haven'?t)\b|\byou (?:never|didn'?t)(?: ever)? (?:told|tell|lent|gave|give|buy|bought|make|made)\b|\bi (?:don'?t|do not) own\b|\bno such\b|\b(?:got|have) the wrong (?:person|one|idea)\b|\bwhat\?

rules.pattern: (?i)\bwhat (?:did|do) i (?:dream|eat|have for)\b|\bwhat(?:'s| is| was) my (?:mom|mother|dad|father|grandma|grandpa|brother|sister|dog|cat|pet|best friend)(?:'s)? name\b|\bwhat am i thinking\b|\bwhere (?:did|do) i (?:go|live|work)\b
rules.hint: {user_name} asked you something you can't know: "{user_line}". Don't make up an answer. Say you don't know, in your own words.
rules.reply_ok: (?i)\bdon'?t know\b|\bdo not know\b|\bno idea\b|\bnot sure\b|\bhow (?:would|should|could|am) i\b.*\bknow\b|\bcan'?t (?:know|read your mind|tell|guess)\b|\byou (?:never|didn'?t|haven'?t)(?: ever)? (?:told|tell|mention\w*|said|talk\w*)\b|\bnever (?:heard you|mentioned)\b|\bi wasn'?t there\b

rules.notes: Matrix (content_policy.md): sweet romance -> J5a (flag TOO_FAR); friendly only -> J5b (flag ROMANTIC). Child characters always J5b.

rules.hint: Keep it sweet and innocent: no kissing scenes, nothing suggestive.
rules.notes: Never allowed for anyone. Retry at once; still there after the last retry -> fallback line. Watch false alarms ('Sexton', 'licked the spoon') in Phase 5.

rules.pattern: (?i)\b(?:kill(?:ing)? myself|suicid\w*|end (?:it all|my life)|want(?:ed)? to die|wanna die|don'?t want to (?:live|be alive|wake up)|self[- ]?harm\w*|cut(?:ting)? myself|hurt(?:ing)? myself|no reason to live|better off without me|can'?t go on|take my (?:own )?life)\b
rules.hint: {user_name} may be going through something really hard. Be kind and gentle, take it seriously, and encourage them to talk to someone they trust. Stay {name}, but drop any harshness.
rules.notes: J6 RISK -> show the crisis note (judge_prompts.json crisis_note) and add the crisis reminder BEFORE the reply is written. If the judge is off, the word rule alone triggers it.

rules.hint: Never give real-world instructions for weapons, drugs, hacking or harm. Refuse the way {name} would.
rules.notes: Reminder is added before the reply is written. If the reply still contains steps (list_lines) -> retry, then fallback refusal.

rules.template: {other_names} = every relationship name in the pack (not the character, not the user)

rules.notes: Body details that ARE in the pack's appearance (e.g. Sukuna's extra eyes, Zoro's scar) are allowed: the app removes matches that appear in the appearance text before deciding.

rules.fix: trim to the last full sentence if that keeps >= 1/3, else end with '…' (TQQ trimToSentence)
